diagnosis: Original intermittent provider failure is not reproduced in three observation-only trials (74/82/82 stable samples). One traced clock/audio interruption also reduces paint progress, so it is not waived as counter sampling. Full-frame image allocation is a measured resource defect; GC pauses alone do not establish the original failure cause.
policy: Unchanged >=500ms clock delta plus positive audio, native picture and paint deltas for >=30 consecutive one-second observations; no added restart, relaxed deadline, or silent reclassification of prior failures. The first post-recovery comparison now starts at the observed recovery sample.
remainingGates: Original intermittent recovery failure causal diagnosis
